stages.name: MECHANISM_AND_ADAPTER_PREFLIGHT
stages.requirement: Exact pinned Stirrup source, execution profile, and required Brain artifact tools available.

stages.decision: Systemic harness/integration failure returns to route race/integration correction; never repair a graded task and count replay as fresh.
stages.execute: Brain-owned Stirrup profile on approved zero-incremental cognition substrate.
stages.name: CHEAP_CROSS_ARTIFACT_FALSIFICATION
stages.selection: Deterministically select a small public-GDPval subset from task IDs before reading prompts, spanning at least three requested artifact classes when feasible.
stages.verify: Task-permitted format checks plus available public automated grader or blind comparison only after outputs freeze.

stages.name: MATCHED_PROFESSIONAL_WORK_COMPARISON
stages.requirement: Broad uncontaminated task sample and scoring comparable enough to the Opus 5.5 target.

target_reference.note: Whole-benchmark point estimate, not a per-task deterministic threshold.
